title: NameError: name 'VOLUME_STP' is not defined
message: The variable 'VOLUME_STP' is not defined in the function where it's being used.
suggestion: Define 'VOLUME_STP' at the beginning of the function or import it if it's supposed to be from another module.

title: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'rstrip'
message: The error occurred because the variable `OPEN_TARGETS[target]` is `None`, and you are trying to call `.rstrip()` on it. This likely happened due to a missing or incorrect initialization of `OPEN_TARGETS`. The culprit is the function `open_target` in `main.py`.
suggestion: Check if `target` is correctly mapped in `OPEN_TARGETS` before calling `.rstrip()`. Ensure that `OPEN_TARGETS` is properly initialized and contains the expected keys.

title: HTTPException: osascript is not allowed assistive access. (-1719)
message: The error is due to the application not having assistive access enabled on the macOS system. This is a configuration issue.
suggestion: Enable assistive access for your application in System Preferences > Security & Privacy > Privacy > Accessibility.

title: TimeoutExpired: Command '['osascript', '-e', 'tell application "System Events" to key code 126']' timed out aft…
message: The command timed out because the system event to press the key code took longer than expected.
suggestion: Check if the Mac remote application is responding or try restarting it.

title: Message: display sleep failed: pmset returned a non-zero exit code
message: The display sleep failed because pmset is not allowed to assistive access. This is likely due to a configuration issue or missing permissions.
suggestion: Check the system settings and ensure that assistive access is enabled for your application.
